notes: First local enable establishes a complete issue #177 high-water and ignores historical requests.
Every request binds current standing-grant id and SHA-256; any mismatch refuses before write.
Open correction debt or witness investigation blocks the remote routine lane.
Request state is durably pre-armed before worker launch to prevent redispatch after a post-launch bookkeeping fault.

A POST attempt without a trusted receipt is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and disables the bridge; a returned write receipt followed by witness/bookkeeping failure is WRITE_OCCURRED_UNVERIFIED and disables the bridge.
No Square write retry exists. One recovery attempt may repost only the GitHub evidence response.
Connector app metadata is a transport-route discriminator, not model/runtime identity proof.
